lastTask: Implement Byte 11a automatic melody slow-thinking loop

projectState.summary: Byte 11a is approved by Claude, merged to main, and pushed. The invalid-200 smoke fixture is in place, and melody has an automatic slow-thinking loop gated by playing transport, rehearsal mode, and ready Ollama health. The loop sends one request at a time, passes abort signals, marks melody thinking while pending, stores accepted/invalid/failed/retargeted state in the Thoughts inspector and `window.thinking.getSlowLoop()`, and still does not schedule model output into audio. Build/audit/diff were green in review and smoke was 14/14. Byte 11b should extract a slow-thinking controller, create an explicit accepted-intent handoff, and compile only a narrow bounded rest or density change into future playback with retarget/thrash guards.
